newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rises, ignores late Big Board nervousness.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rises, ignores late Big Board nervousness.

text.p: Nasdaq shares defied late selling among the Dow industrials Tuesday, as networking stocks recovered slightly from recent selloffs.

The Nasdaq composite index gained about six points or 0.47 percent to close unofficially at 1317. The Dow Industrials shed 66 points to an unofficial close of 6853 in late-session nervousness ahead of Wednesday's testimony by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.
"The over-the-counter market behaved, but the Big Board fell apart at the end of the day. There was some strength in some of the tech stocks that helped the OTC hold strong," one trader said.

Networking stocks posted moderate gains Tuesday after last week's broad selloff sparked by the proposed acquisition of modem maker U.S. Robotics Corp by 3Com Corp. U.S. Robotics gained 2 to 57-3/8, 3Com added 1 to 33-13/16, and Ascend Communications Inc jumped 3-5/16 to 58/
In other news, SystemSoft Corp fell 5-3/16 to 11-13/16 after a Hambrecht & Quist analyst downgraded the stock and trimmed earnings estimates.
Overall, gaining issues only slightly beat declining issues 2167 to 2107 on total volume of 607 million shares.
